integrity: All enumerations, group actions and certificate data are reproducible from the enclosed sources; no claim of independent external review.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact theorem for the specified 30-vertex graph; no generalization to other cubic graphs. The 288 perfect matchings and 144 Hamiltonian cycles are previously reported scalar facts, not newly claimed. Exact priority remains uncertain if an earlier unindexed ordinary three-edge-coloring classification exists. The exhaustive finite proof is reproduced by two standalone implementations.
title: The 144 edge one-factorizations of the Tutte–Coxeter graph form a single symmetry class
